Title: Microsoft Azure Load Testing - additional Azure components for server-side monitoring

Body.Content:
Azure Load Testing provides the option of monitoring server-side components while running a load test. This helps you correlate the server-side component behavior with the client metrics and easily identify performance bottlenecks. 

You can now select additional types of Azure resources for server-side monitoring: Azure Container Apps, Azure Cognitive Services, Azure Database for MySQL Flexible Server, etc.  

See the full list of supported Azure resource types.
